text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score over all leads (smaller is better), after the 14-day error correction and spread factor of 1.15. Blue: one model per series. Light blue: pooled with the series ID. Orange: pooled without it. Grey: references. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re- drawing whole months and seeds. 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026, ENS weather.'
